question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.

It is __*absurd* __to argue about this.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3' **i.e. **'Reasonable'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'absurd'** in English means something that is wildly unreasonable, illogical, or inappropriate.(बेतुका)
 
• The **antonym of 'absurd'** would be something that is logical, appropriate, or reasonable.
 
• **'Reasonable' **means being in accordance with reason or logic, which is the exact opposite of 'absurd'.(तर्कसंगत)

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: '**Reasonable'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the other options:
 
 
• **'Facetious' **means treating serious issues with deliberately inappropriate humor; flippant. (हंसमुख)
 
• **'Fundamental'** means forming a necessary base or core; of central importance.(मौलिक)
 
• **'Amazing'** means causing great surprise or wonder; astonishing.(आश्चर्यजनक)
